notes.title: Stage 3,4,5, and 6 Update, Remake & Bug Fix
notes.content:
We have updated stages 4 and 5 to allow for more use of dodging and healing motion skills, in addition to simple jumping and movement, based on the feedback we received.

[u][b]Stage 3 Update[/b][/u]

More items and upgrade monsters have been added.


[u][b]Stage 4 Update[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Sleeping monsters have been added.

[*] The rotating tree has been resized so that it can no longer be traversed by jumping alone without using skills.

[*] The platforms on the rotating objects have been increased in size to make them easier to jump on. However, monsters have been added and placed in positions that require the use of skills to avoid in order to progress.
[/list]


[u][b]Stage 5 Update[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Scarecrows have been added in various locations so that their patterns can be seen from any direction.

[*] The instant death traps have been changed to regular damage traps. (Except Scarecrow)

[*] Various traps have been changed or added to allow for avoidance using a variety of skills.

[*] The speed of traps that were rotating too quickly has been adjusted.
[/list]


[u][b]Stage 6 Update[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] More smoke has been added to stage 6.
[/list]


[u][b]Bug Fix[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of the screen freezing when the revive button is pressed while ranking screen is open.

[*] Italian language is added.

[*] Fixed reset of language.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Version Last Update & Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello!

With only a few days left until release, this is the final update for the demo version.


[b]1. Updates[/b]

- Implemented a loading screen for the ranking screen.

- If your own ID is included in the rankings, it will be indicated by a border.

- You can now change the location of your skills in the inventory by dragging the mouse.

- Loading screen is changed.



[b]2. Bug fixes and adjustments[/b]

- Fixed an issue where it was impossible to re-equip a skill after it was released.

- Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor range for shortcuts was too narrow.

- Fixed an issue where the entire screen changed to full screen when changing scenes.

- Changed the position of the check mark in the help window.

- Modified the resurrection help window to be closed with 'ESC' too not only 'F' key.



There were a few more updates and fixes, but I can't remember them because I cleared the record..

Other updates were applied to the stages in the official version, so I didn't list them.

I'm trying to focus on resolving issues that prevent players from progressing in the game as much as possible.

[u]Also, I've slightly lowered the overall difficulty.[/u]

Although it's getting a little more difficult as you progress, I'm trying to make it at a level that can be easily tackled compared to other challenging platform games that I've played.

With only about 10 days left, I'm working hard to make as many people as possible enjoy it.

I sincerely thank those who have added it to their wish list, given feedback, supported me, and played the demo version.!!!! ^~^
